thread:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — planning a small config change to the Dedicated reserved pool autoscaler: reduce eviction aggressiveness and nudge pool weights (+10%) for low-priority slices. Targeting today 21:00 UTC. Estimated impact: 5–10m for rolling config apply, no model restarts. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Alex Chen: tagging @Sam Rivera — are you the deploy owner for this window?

Sam Rivera: I can run it. Will be available at 20:50 UTC to validate precheck and then kick the change at 21:00.

Jen Ortiz: I'll own smoke checks and observability. Plan: quick load smoke (10 concurrent requests) + KV cache sanity + tail tail logs for error spikes. Script below:
```bash
# smoke.sh
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/serve/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-medium","input":"smoke test"}' | jq '.output'
# run this 10x in parallel, check 2xx and latency < 200ms p95
```

Maya Patel: Good. Also run `kubectl get pods -n dedicated-pool` to confirm no draining beyond expected. If any pod shows CrashLoop, rollback immediately.

Sam Rivera: Understood. I'll run a dry-run first: `./infra/deploy-tools/apply-config --pool reserved-low --dry-run` and paste output here.

deploy-bot: CI status: config-change-checks — passed (unit + lint), 1 vulnerable image flagged (nonblocking). Link: https://ci.redwood.example/ci/7890 :white_check_mark:

Luis Gomez: Rollback plan: restore previous config from s3://configs/dedicated/pool-weights/2026-09-12.json and run `apply-config --force`. If we see >0.5% 5xx across serving for 3 consecutive minutes, we trigger rollback.

Nora (sre-oncall): I'll monitor the alerting channel and spot checks on traces. Callout: if latency p95 climbs >100ms over baseline, escalate to pagers.

Alex Chen: Quick question — does the config touch autoscaler thresholds or only eviction/weights?

Maya Patel: Only eviction_policy and weight fields. No threshold change. Verified by config diff: `git diff --staged infra/pool-configs/reserved-low.yaml` (small JSON patch).

Jen Ortiz: I'll run smoke 1m before and at +2m/+5m after change. Will paste aggregated results.

Sam Rivera: Dry-run output (paste):
```
DRY-RUN: apply-config --pool reserved-low
  changes:
    - eviction_policy: "less-aggressive" (was "aggressive")
    - weights.reserved-low: 1.10 (was 1.00)
    - annotation: "eviction tuning, phI"
No pod restarts required. Plan to patch config via operator.
```

Maya Patel: OK. If smoke looks clean at +5m, we'll let it sit. If anything odd, we'll roll back and open a quick post-mortem. Thanks team — @Sam please post deploy start/complete messages and include the operator patch command you run. :rocket:
